ssh.title: SSH keys: {name}
ssh.unsupported: This server's control panel does not support SSH key management.

failures.Unreachable: the server could not be reached
failures.UnsupportedVersion: the agent version is not supported
failures.UnknownOperation: the agent does not support this operation
failures.InvalidAccount: the account name is not valid
failures.AccountNotEligible: the account cannot have managed keys
failures.SshDisabled: shell access is disabled for the account
failures.KeyIdConflict: the key id is already in use
failures.TooManyKeys: the account reached its key limit

ssh.enabled: Customers on this server may manage SSH keys
ssh.enabledHint: Enabling requires a successful test with the saved settings, and never turns on shell access for any account.
ssh.agentHostHint: What HostPanel connects to for key operations.
ssh.fingerprintHint: Printed by install.sh; connections to any other host key are refused.
ssh.privateKeyHint: The OpenSSH private key whose public half install.sh pinned to the agent.
ssh.privateKeyStoredHint: A key is stored and is never shown. Leave empty to keep it.
ssh.privateKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the stored key
ssh.connectionHint: Save the connection before the next steps: they use the saved settings.
ssh.saveFieldErrors: Not saved: check the highlighted fields.
ssh.networkIntro: HostPanel connects from {addresses}. On the server, allow only that address on the agent port with the line for its firewall:
ssh.networkSshd: OpenSSH 9.8 or later: add to /etc/ssh/sshd_config, then reload sshd
ssh.networkUnset: Set SshAgent__SourceAddresses to the address this HostPanel connects from (as the server sees it) to get ready-made firewall lines here.
ssh.networkVpn: Using a VPN or private network instead? Enter the server's address on it as the agent host; the host this HostPanel runs on must be in that network.
ssh.installIntro: Profile: {profile}. HostPanel generates a management key for this server only and serves agent {version}.
ssh.rotateWarning: Rotating switches SSH key management off until the installer is run again with the new key.
ssh.runAsRoot: Run as root on the server, in an SSH session (a browser console such as CWP's Terminal can alter the command and break it):
ssh.installVerifies: The command stops unless the download's SHA256 is {sha}.
ssh.hostKeyIntro: Read the key the agent endpoint presents and compare it with the fingerprint the installer printed on the server. Pin it only if they are identical.
ssh.bindingMismatch: The agent that answered was installed for a different server. Check the agent host, or run this server's installer command on it.
ssh.advanced: Advanced: use an existing management key
